instruction:
1. Format the document title as follows: LiSu, size No. 2, bold, blue, Glow (Olive Green, 7 pt glow, Accent 3), Shadow (Offset: Top), center alignment, and 20 pt spacing after the paragraph.
2. Format the body text in KaiTi, size Small No. 4, with a first-line indent of 2 characters, 6 pt spacing after each paragraph, and 1.1 line spacing.
3. Apply a drop cap to “The Majors Offered Are as Follows” in the third paragraph: position it In margin, set it to drop 2 lines, and set the distance from text to 0.3 cm.
4. Replace “Department of Intelligent Engineering” with “Department of Intelligent Software Engineering,” and format it in SimSun, size No. 4, bold italic, green, with emphasis marks.
5. Use the image as the watermark background of the introduction document, apply “Washout,” and set the scale to 100%.

dim1: The deliverable is in .docx format and opens successfully.

The document retains the title “Introduction to the Department of Intelligent Software Engineering” and the body introduction content; the body paragraphs, list of majors, and main text remain editable text.
The document has no consecutive blank pages and no garbled text, overlapping text, images obscuring the body text, or severely disordered layout affecting more than 1/3 of a page.
The watermark image in the document is an editable Word picture watermark or header background object; the body text has not been converted into an image or screenshot.
dim2: +1: Document title paragraph: “Introduction to the Department of Intelligent Software Engineering” is on the first line of the document and uses LiSu, size No. 2, bold, blue, center alignment, and 20 pt spacing after the paragraph.

+3: Document title paragraph: “Introduction to the Department of Intelligent Software Engineering” has a glow effect, with an olive-green or near-olive-green glow color, a glow size of approximately 7 pt, and Accent 3 or a similar effect. “Introduction to the Department of Intelligent Software Engineering” has an upward-offset shadow effect, while the title text remains clearly readable. ()

+1: Body paragraphs overall: Except for the title, the special initial character in the paragraph containing “The Majors Offered Are as Follows:”, and the special formatting of the replaced text “Department of Intelligent Software Engineering,” the body text uses KaiTi, size Small No. 4, a first-line indent of 2 characters, 6 pt spacing after each paragraph, and 1.1 line spacing.

+5: The third paragraph, containing “The Majors Offered Are as Follows:”: A drop cap is applied to the text at the beginning of the paragraph, with the drop-cap position set to In margin, a drop of 2 lines, and a distance from text of 0.3 cm. After the drop cap is applied, the rest of the paragraph remains in KaiTi, size Small No. 4, with 1.1 line spacing, without causing overlapping text or a broken paragraph.
+1: The text “Department of Intelligent Engineering” does not appear in the document.
+1: “Department of Intelligent Software Engineering” in the body text uses SimSun, size No. 4, bold, italic, green, with emphasis marks added.

+5: Document watermark background: The campus banner image is set as the watermark background for the entire introduction document, displayed behind the body text, at a scale of 100% or close to 100%.
+3: Document watermark effect: The watermark image has “Washout” or an obviously faded effect applied, and the body text remains clearly readable above the watermark.

+1: Document watermark scope: The watermark appears in the page background area, does not occupy a paragraph position as an ordinary image inserted into the body, and does not compress the body text layout.
-5: After replacement, “Department of Intelligent Software Engineering” contains missing or incorrect characters.
-3: The watermark image is severely cropped, stretched or distorted, or obscures the body text.
